standard_prerequisites.name: Standard Morse theory, cotangent symplectic geometry and author-cited Weinstein/Lefschetz facts
standard_prerequisites.use: All original cited inputs, source-local definitions and complete author construction retained; no recursive reproof.

core_obligations: The author explicitly constructs the real part of a cotangent Lefschetz map with prescribed imaginary part from an adapted Morse-Smale gradient, glues local Morse models while maintaining the required Poisson-bracket geometry, and controls the homogeneous extension near infinity. The original proof also provides equivariance, the boundary retraction and the contractibility formulation of homotopical uniqueness.
